Container.Name: plexgaps
Container.Overview: PlexGaps scans your Plex library and lists the episodes you are missing for each series, and the movies you are missing from each franchise (TMDB collection). Everything is set up in the web UI: enter your Plex URL, Plex token and a free TMDB API key on the Settings tab, test the connection, pick your libraries and scan. Results are cached and refreshed on a schedule, and any series or franchise can be ignored. Requires a Plex Media Server and a free TMDB API key.
Container.Requires: A Plex Media Server and a free TMDB API key (themoviedb.org, Settings, API). Both are entered in the web UI.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port to reach the PlexGaps web interface on

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Stores settings, scan results and the ignore list

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Optional starting value, for example http://192.168.1.10:32400. Can be set in the web UI instead.

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Optional starting value. Can be set in the web UI instead.

Config.Name: TMDB API Key
Config.Description: Optional starting value. TMDB v3 API key or v4 read access token. Can be set in the web UI instead.

Config.Name: TV Libraries
Config.Description: Optional starting value. Comma separated library names. Empty means all TV libraries.

Config.Name: Movie Libraries
Config.Description: Optional starting value. Comma separated library names. Empty means all movie libraries.

Config.Name: Scan Interval (hours)
Config.Description: Optional starting value. Hours between automatic scans. 0 disables automatic scans.

Config.Name: Include Specials
Config.Description: Optional starting value. Count season 0 episodes as missing.

Config.Name: Include Unaired
Config.Description: Optional starting value. List episodes and movies that are not released yet.
